new_workflow_operations.before:
$ownerApi = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP ('carr-voice-owner-api-' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N'))
          $acquireOwner = @'
          import importlib.util,json,pathlib,sys
          source=pathlib.Path('scripts/ci_owner_voice_api_smoke.py').resolve(strict=True)
          spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('exact_owner_api_acquisition',source)
          module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
          sys.modules[spec.name]=module
          spec.loader.exec_module(module)
          _,receipts=module.acquire(pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]))
          proof={'schema':'carr-owner-api-acquisition/1','owner_revision':module.REVISION,
                 'files':receipts,'payload_retained_publicly':False}
          pathlib.Path('ci-voice-acceptance/owner-api-acquisition.json').write_text(
              json.dumps(proof,sort_keys=True,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
          '@
          $acquireOwner | & python -I -B -X utf8 - $ownerApi
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Exact owner metadata closure acquisition failed.' }
          "CARR_VOICE_OWNER_API_DIR=$ownerApi" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_ENV -Encoding utf8 -Append
